market_title: BTC price up in next 15 mins?

strike.note: 60-second average of the CF Benchmarks real-time index before the window opened. Published by the exchange; this is the actual number the contract settles against.

spot.note: Coinbase spot is a proxy for the CF Benchmarks index. Basis between them is usually a few dollars on BTC and is a real error term near the strike.

model.name: driftless_lognormal_v1
model.note: MODELED, not measured. P(up) = Phi(ln(spot/strike) / (sigma * sqrt(tau_eff))) with sigma = realized vol of Coinbase 1-minute log returns over the lookback and tau_eff = seconds remaining minus 2/3 of the 60s settlement average. Assumes zero drift, constant vol, and that Coinbase spot tracks the CF Benchmarks index. Every one of those is wrong sometimes; the band shows how much the number moves if vol is 25% off.

polymarket.resolution: Chainlink BTC/USD 60s TWAP — a different index from Kalshi's, so this is an opinion on a correlated question, not the same one.

decision.reason: 133s remaining < 180s minimum — the last minutes are a coin toss on the settlement average, not a model
